# M5-S2: imported const func boundary values and types (T-201, T-Sec6, R-U2).
# Anchor: Tony Hoare, Richard Feynman
#
# Tests cross-package compile-time evaluation and boundary behavior:
# 1. Private named integer result as package const and local const,
#    verifying constant array bounds, methods, and %T representation,
#    with exported named and basic typed scalar controls.
# 2. Private struct result with an unexported field exposed only through
#    an exported read method, surviving native execution and plain-Go eject.
# 3. Named private slice result with len < cap and initialized tail,
#    preserving len/cap, elements, and methods while respecting const-view
#    len-bound policy in Logos; Go caller inspects spare capacity tail.
# 4. Const map with private named value type passed to const funcs,
#    verifying copy-on-argument protection and comma-ok lookup/iteration.
# 5. Readonly storage witness for a foreign-imported computed slice with
#    spare capacity, using a separate Go child process attempting a write.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# 1. Consumer module evaluates imported const funcs at compile time.
cd consumer
logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/want.txt
stdout '^priv-int: 7 3$'
stdout '^priv-int-methods: 14 6$'
stdout '^priv-int-types: produce\.privateInt produce\.privateInt$'
stdout '^priv-int-derived: 8 16$'
stdout '^priv-int-forwarded: 7 14$'
stdout '^priv-int-derived-type: produce\.privateInt$'
stdout '^control-vals: 20 15 105 102$'
stdout '^control-methods: 21 16$'
stdout '^control-types: produce\.ExportedInt int$'
stdout '^bound-lens: 7 3$'
stdout '^struct-getter: code=42 realm=vault$'
stdout '^struct-method-id: code=42 realm=vault$'
stdout '^priv-slice: len=3 cap=5 elems=10,20,30 sum=60$'
stdout '^exp-slice: len=3 cap=5 elems=11,22,33 total=66$'
stdout '^map-const-eval: alpha=20 beta=40 missing=-1$'
stdout '^map-arg-copy: mut=999 after=20$'
stdout '^map-comma-ok: a=10,true b=20,true c=false$'
stdout '^map-entry-method: 20$'
stdout '^map-order: alpha,beta$'
stdout '^opaque-slice: len=3 cap=5 elems=1000,3000$'

# 2. Eject consumer module to plain Go and verify parity.
logos eject -o ../eject_out
exists ../eject_out/main.go
cd ../eject_out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
cd ../consumer
cd ..

# 3. Plain Go caller module sees ordinary function semantics, inspects tails,
# and executes the readonly storage witness child process.
cd gocaller
logos run .
stdout '^gocaller-struct: code=99 realm=go-secret$'
stdout '^gocaller-priv-slice: len=3 cap=5 sum=60 tail=40,50$'
stdout '^gocaller-exp-slice: len=3 cap=5 total=66 tail=44,55$'
stdout '^gocaller-map: alpha=20$'
stdout '^gocaller-opaque-tail: len=5 cap=5 tail=4000,5000$'
stdout '^snapshot-slice: len=3 cap=5 sum=60 tail=40,50$'
stdout '^rodata-witness: fault OK$'
cd ..

-- lib/go.mod --
module example.com/valuelib

go 1.27

-- lib/produce/produce.lgo --
package produce

// 1. Private named integer type with method.
type privateInt int

func (p privateInt) Double() int {
	return int(p) * 2
}

const func MakePrivateInt(x int) privateInt {
	return privateInt(x)
}

// Exported named integer control.
type ExportedInt int

func (e ExportedInt) Inc() ExportedInt {
	return e + 1
}

const func MakeExportedInt(x int) ExportedInt {
	return ExportedInt(x)
}

// Basic typed scalar control.
const func MakeBasicInt(x int) int {
	return x + 100
}

// 2. Private struct result with unexported field.
type privateSecret struct {
	hiddenCode int
	realm      string
}

func (s privateSecret) Code() int {
	return s.hiddenCode
}

func (s privateSecret) Realm() string {
	return s.realm
}

const func MakePrivateSecret(code int, realm string) privateSecret {
	return privateSecret{hiddenCode: code, realm: realm}
}

// 3. Named private slice with len < cap and initialized tail.
type privateSlice []int

func (s privateSlice) Sum() int {
	tot := 0
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		tot += s[i]
	}
	return tot
}

const func MakePrivateSliceWithTail() privateSlice {
	full := privateSlice{10, 20, 30, 40, 50}
	return full[:3]
}

// Exported slice control with spare capacity.
type ExportedSlice []int

func (s ExportedSlice) Total() int {
	tot := 0
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		tot += s[i]
	}
	return tot
}

const func MakeExportedSliceWithTail() ExportedSlice {
	full := ExportedSlice{11, 22, 33, 44, 55}
	return full[:3]
}

// 4. Const map with private named value type.
type privateEntry struct {
	Weight int
}

func (e privateEntry) Doubled() int {
	return e.Weight * 2
}

const func MakeConstMap() map[string]privateEntry {
	return map[string]privateEntry{
		"beta":  privateEntry{Weight: 20},
		"alpha": privateEntry{Weight: 10},
	}
}

const func LookupConstMap(m map[string]privateEntry, key string) int {
	entry, ok := m[key]
	if ok {
		return entry.Weight * 2
	}
	return -1
}

const func MutateMapArg(m map[string]privateEntry, key string, newWeight int) int {
	m[key] = privateEntry{Weight: newWeight}
	entry, ok := m[key]
	if ok {
		return entry.Weight
	}
	return 0
}

// 5. Exported computed opaque slice with spare capacity.
type OpaqueTag int

func (t OpaqueTag) Code() int {
	return int(t) * 10
}

const func MakeOpaqueSliceWithTail() []OpaqueTag {
	full := []OpaqueTag{100, 200, 300, 400, 500}
	return full[:3]
}

const ExportedOpaqueSlice = MakeOpaqueSliceWithTail()

-- lib/snapshot/snapshot.lgo --
package snapshot

import "example.com/valuelib/produce"

// Snapshot is a const defined OUTSIDE the defining package of privateSlice,
// computed from an imported const func. This exercises foreign opaque
// keepCall and spare-capacity handling.
const Snapshot = produce.MakePrivateSliceWithTail()

-- consumer/go.mod --
module example.com/consumer

go 1.27

require example.com/valuelib v0.0.0

replace example.com/valuelib => ../lib

-- consumer/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/valuelib/produce"
)

// Const initializers forcing compile-time evaluation.
const (
	// Case 1: Package const private named int and controls.
	PkgPrivateInt  = produce.MakePrivateInt(7)
	PkgExportedInt = produce.MakeExportedInt(20)
	PkgBasicInt    = produce.MakeBasicInt(5)
	DerivedPrivateInt   = produce.MakePrivateInt(7) + 1
	ForwardedPrivateInt = PkgPrivateInt

	// Case 2: Private struct result.
	SecretVal = produce.MakePrivateSecret(42, "vault")

	// Case 3: Slices with spare capacity.
	PrivSliceVal = produce.MakePrivateSliceWithTail()
	ExpSliceVal  = produce.MakeExportedSliceWithTail()

	// Case 4: Const map with private named value type.
	RecordedMap    = produce.MakeConstMap()
	LookupAlpha    = produce.LookupConstMap(RecordedMap, "alpha")
	LookupBeta     = produce.LookupConstMap(RecordedMap, "beta")
	LookupMissing  = produce.LookupConstMap(RecordedMap, "gamma")
	MutatedAlpha   = produce.MutateMapArg(RecordedMap, "alpha", 999)
	LookupAfterMut = produce.LookupConstMap(RecordedMap, "alpha")

	// Case 5: Exported computed opaque slice with spare capacity.
	ConsumerOpaqueSlice = produce.MakeOpaqueSliceWithTail()
)

// Constant array bounds proving compile-time integer constant semantics.
type PkgPrivateBound [PkgPrivateInt]byte

func checkInts() {
	const (
		localPrivateInt  = produce.MakePrivateInt(3)
		localExportedInt = produce.MakeExportedInt(15)
		localBasicInt    = produce.MakeBasicInt(2)
	)
	type LocalPrivateBound [localPrivateInt]byte

	var _ PkgPrivateBound
	var _ LocalPrivateBound

	fmt.Printf("priv-int: %d %d\n", PkgPrivateInt, localPrivateInt)
	fmt.Printf("priv-int-methods: %d %d\n", PkgPrivateInt.Double(), localPrivateInt.Double())
	fmt.Printf("priv-int-types: %T %T\n", PkgPrivateInt, localPrivateInt)
	fmt.Printf("priv-int-derived: %d %d\n", DerivedPrivateInt, DerivedPrivateInt.Double())
	fmt.Printf("priv-int-forwarded: %d %d\n", ForwardedPrivateInt, ForwardedPrivateInt.Double())
	fmt.Printf("priv-int-derived-type: %T\n", DerivedPrivateInt)
	fmt.Printf("control-vals: %d %d %d %d\n", PkgExportedInt, localExportedInt, PkgBasicInt, localBasicInt)
	fmt.Printf("control-methods: %d %d\n", PkgExportedInt.Inc(), localExportedInt.Inc())
	fmt.Printf("control-types: %T %T\n", PkgExportedInt, PkgBasicInt)
	fmt.Printf("bound-lens: %d %d\n", len(PkgPrivateBound{}), len(LocalPrivateBound{}))
}

func checkStruct() {
	sec := SecretVal
	var readCode func() int = sec.Code
	var readRealm func() string = sec.Realm
	fmt.Printf("struct-getter: code=%d realm=%s\n", sec.Code(), sec.Realm())
	fmt.Printf("struct-method-id: code=%d realm=%s\n", readCode(), readRealm())
}

func checkSlices() {
	ps := PrivSliceVal
	fmt.Printf("priv-slice: len=%d cap=%d elems=%d,%d,%d sum=%d\n",
		len(ps), cap(ps), ps[0], ps[1], ps[2], ps.Sum())

	es := ExpSliceVal
	fmt.Printf("exp-slice: len=%d cap=%d elems=%d,%d,%d total=%d\n",
		len(es), cap(es), es[0], es[1], es[2], es.Total())
}

func checkMaps() {
	entryA, okA := RecordedMap["alpha"]
	entryB, okB := RecordedMap["beta"]
	_, okC := RecordedMap["gamma"]

	fmt.Printf("map-const-eval: alpha=%d beta=%d missing=%d\n",
		LookupAlpha, LookupBeta, LookupMissing)
	fmt.Printf("map-arg-copy: mut=%d after=%d\n",
		MutatedAlpha, LookupAfterMut)
	fmt.Printf("map-comma-ok: a=%d,%t b=%d,%t c=%t\n",
		entryA.Weight, okA, entryB.Weight, okB, okC)
	fmt.Printf("map-entry-method: %d\n", entryA.Doubled())

	// Sorted key iteration per SPEC 9.1: single ordered sequence.
	order := ""
	for k := range RecordedMap {
		if order != "" {
			order += ","
		}
		order += k
	}
	fmt.Printf("map-order: %s\n", order)
}

func checkOpaque() {
	fmt.Printf("opaque-slice: len=%d cap=%d elems=%d,%d\n",
		len(ConsumerOpaqueSlice), cap(ConsumerOpaqueSlice),
		ConsumerOpaqueSlice[0].Code(), ConsumerOpaqueSlice[2].Code())
}

func main() {
	checkInts()
	checkStruct()
	checkSlices()
	checkMaps()
	checkOpaque()
}

-- gocaller/go.mod --
module example.com/gocaller

go 1.27

require example.com/valuelib v0.0.0

replace example.com/valuelib => ../lib

-- gocaller/main.go --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"

	"example.com/valuelib/produce"
	"example.com/valuelib/snapshot"
)

func runWitness() {
	self, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("witness-error: %v\n", err)
		return
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(self, "child-rodata-write")
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stdout = &buf
	cmd.Stderr = &buf
	runErr := cmd.Run()
	code := -1
	if ee, ok := runErr.(*exec.ExitError); ok {
		code = ee.ExitCode()
	}
	out := buf.String()
	faulted := code != 0 && strings.Contains(out, "fault") && !strings.Contains(out, "STORE-SUCCEEDED")
	if faulted {
		fmt.Println("rodata-witness: fault OK")
	} else {
		fmt.Printf("rodata-witness: store succeeded (code=%d out=%q)\n", code, out)
	}
}

func checkGoSemantics() {
	sec := produce.MakePrivateSecret(99, "go-secret")
	fmt.Printf("gocaller-struct: code=%d realm=%s\n", sec.Code(), sec.Realm())

	gps := produce.MakePrivateSliceWithTail()
	gpsTail := gps[:cap(gps)]
	fmt.Printf("gocaller-priv-slice: len=%d cap=%d sum=%d tail=%d,%d\n",
		len(gps), cap(gps), gps.Sum(), gpsTail[3], gpsTail[4])

	ges := produce.MakeExportedSliceWithTail()
	gesTail := ges[:cap(ges)]
	fmt.Printf("gocaller-exp-slice: len=%d cap=%d total=%d tail=%d,%d\n",
		len(ges), cap(ges), ges.Total(), gesTail[3], gesTail[4])

	cmap := produce.MakeConstMap()
	alphaVal := produce.LookupConstMap(cmap, "alpha")
	fmt.Printf("gocaller-map: alpha=%d\n", alphaVal)

	tail := produce.ExportedOpaqueSlice[:cap(produce.ExportedOpaqueSlice)]
	fmt.Printf("gocaller-opaque-tail: len=%d cap=%d tail=%d,%d\n",
		len(tail), cap(tail), tail[3].Code(), tail[4].Code())

	// Inspect snapshot defined in foreign package from imported private slice const func.
	snapTail := snapshot.Snapshot[:cap(snapshot.Snapshot)]
	fmt.Printf("snapshot-slice: len=%d cap=%d sum=%d tail=%d,%d\n",
		len(snapshot.Snapshot), cap(snapshot.Snapshot), snapshot.Snapshot.Sum(), snapTail[3], snapTail[4])
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "child-rodata-write" {
		snapshot.Snapshot[0] = 9999
		fmt.Println("STORE-SUCCEEDED")
		return
	}
	checkGoSemantics()
	runWitness()
}
